peak.definition: first global maximum of the selected scenario series over the packaged model horizon

severe_deterioration.collapse_label_for_single_indicator: forbidden unless a domain-specific scientific definition separately justifies it

systemic_collapse_window.label_rule: emit systemic collapse window only when the primary quorum is satisfied

scenario_alignment.evaluation_period: years with both observation and scenario value
not: prospective forecast skill unless separately demonstrated

event_timing_sensitivity.scenario_range: minimum to maximum identified event year across original BAU, original BAU2 and BAU Hybrid 2026
event_timing_sensitivity.required_for_parameter_event_time_interv: versioned coherent ensemble-member trajectories or an explicitly calibrated event-time distribution

p10_p90_audit.public_label_ro: Afișează intervalul de sensibilitate al modelului (P10–P90)
p10_p90_audit.candidate_design: one baseline plus 127 Latin Hypercube samples
p10_p90_audit.sampling_method: scipy.stats.qmc.LatinHypercube scaled independently across the seven declared dimensions; no explicit parameter-correlation matrix is imposed by the sampling code
p10_p90_audit.fixed_parameters: all other structural parameters of the packaged World3-03 scenario-2 run remain at their scenario values; a custom switch permits the initial-resource parameter above to vary
p10_p90_audit.ensemble_selection: 12 best production candidates satisfying mapping and declared near-term plausibility guardrails
p10_p90_audit.published_band: actual pointwise 10th and 90th percentiles across those accepted candidates at every year
p10_p90_audit.sensitivity_type: parameter/model sensitivity within the admitted calibrated candidate design
p10_p90_audit.not_probability: the candidate ensemble is not a calibrated posterior or predictive distribution, so P10–P90 is not an 80% future-probability interval
p10_p90_audit.event_timing_limit: pointwise P10/P90 curves are not coherent ensemble-member trajectories and cannot supply peak/decline-year probability intervals

product_surface.primary_question: What do World3 and its scenarios say about global trajectories, peaks, decline onsets, systemic deterioration, sensitivity and scenario differences?

intervention_gate.reason: No intervention operator or authoritative intervention trajectory package has passed the project's scientific validation for this release.
intervention_gate.preparedness_semantics: external resilience domains; not country-specific policy prescriptions produced by World3
